description: A neighborhood bookbinder must decide whether to accept a barter-based restoration commission for a fragile cookbook and settle the exact work, exchange, timing, and preservation method after consulting the people gathered in the workshop.

shared_context.S1: Inez has been asked to restore a worn 1920s community cookbook.
shared_context.S2: Inez decides whether to accept the commission and sets the final terms.
shared_context.S3: The cookbook has a detached cover and several loose pages.
shared_context.S4: As part of Inez's usual workshop practice, everyone present states any terms, offers, or material constraints they know before a commission is accepted.

PF1.text: Caleb's exact barter proposal is for Inez to reattach the cover, resew the loose sections, and make a simple cloth spine; in exchange he will provide twelve archival linen sheets plus $40, bring the book Tuesday at 18:00, and collect it Saturday at 16:00.

PF2.text: Rosa has offered Inez $320 cash for a separate two-week restoration of a family recipe ledger, and the offer remains open.

PF3.text: Dev inspected this cookbook for a local archivist, who confirmed that its brittle acidic pages require wheat-starch paste and Japanese tissue for the loose-page repairs; ordinary PVA glue should not be used.

acceptance_conditions: The repair must include reattaching the cover, resewing the loose sections, and making a simple cloth spine.
The barter must include exactly twelve archival linen sheets.
The cash adjustment must be exactly $40.
The book must be delivered Tuesday at 18:00 and collected Saturday at 16:00.
Rosa's $320 cash alternative must be recorded.
The repair must use wheat-starch paste and Japanese tissue rather than ordinary PVA glue.
The material-preservation information must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['repair_scope'] == 'reattach cover; resew loose sections; make simple cloth spine'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'archival_repair_method' and c['target'] == 'cookbook' and c['detail'] == 'wheat-starch paste and Japanese tissue; no ordinary PVA glue' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Caleb's exact proposal changes the accepted client to Caleb, fixes the repair scope, sets the barter at twelve linen sheets plus exactly $40, and fixes Tuesday 18:00 drop-off with Saturday 16:00 pickup.
Rosa's offer changes the comparison record from no concrete alternative to an exact $320 cash option.

The archivist's material finding changes the repair method from an unspecified ordinary repair to wheat-starch paste and Japanese tissue with ordinary PVA excluded, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
